newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil/Texaco spud Gulf of Mexico Fuji wel.
newsitem.headline: Statoil/Texaco spud Gulf of Mexico Fuji wel.

text.p: U.S. oil company Texaco Inc has spudded a well on their Fuji prospect in the Gulf of Mexico, partner Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday.
The well, drilled by Diamond Offshore's Ocean Star rig, lies in block 505 about 280 km southwest of New Orleans. Texaco expected the work to take 115 days, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
In January Statoil agreed to take a 35 percent in the project, which was wholly-owned by Texaco.

Statoil said the well was the first of two planned in order to map the Fuji Basin in more detail. In 1994 Texaco found hydrocarbons in neighbouring block 506. That well was plugged and abandoned in February, 1995.
